$description: Combobox (platform/components/Combobox), library wave 6, lane C: the tokens of its option marks (Checkbox select, Radio select) and its loading and failed-load rows (Async select). The shared Combobox tokens stay in components.tokens.json.

combobox-option-mark-gap.$description: Combobox option with a mark: the space between the checkbox or radio and the label.

combobox-loading-text.$description: Combobox loading row: the text color (the no-matches row's).

combobox-loading-gap.$description: Combobox loading row: the space between the spinner and its text.

combobox-loading-font-size.$description: Combobox loading row: the text size (the no-matches row's).

combobox-loading-padding-block.$description: Combobox loading row: the space above and below (the no-matches row's).

combobox-loading-padding-inline.$description: Combobox loading row: the space at its sides (the no-matches row's).

combobox-error-text.$description: Combobox failed-load row: the text color (the danger content role).

combobox-option-icon-gap.$description: Combobox option with an icon: the space between the icon and the label (the mark gap's).

combobox-option-icon-text.$description: Combobox option: the icon's color (muted, like EntityPicker's description).

combobox-option-description-text.$description: Combobox option: the second line's color (EntityPicker's description color).

combobox-option-description-font-size.$description: Combobox option: the second line's size (EntityPicker's description size).
